hypotheses.statement: A loop-aware content-addressed TurnTraceEnvelope localizes H1/H2 semantic divergence more precisely than final-state-only comparison.
hypotheses.falsifier: Matched H1/H2 runs show that stage-level semantic projection produces frequent false divergence or misses divergences detected by a simpler final-state oracle.

hypotheses.statement: Binding one immutable status snapshot to the exact final semantic/graph basis prevents mixed-epoch status surfaces.
hypotheses.falsifier: A live atomic-snapshot implementation still emits a status surface whose component basis identities cannot be reconciled to one committed state.

hypotheses.statement: Replay identity should include an environment fingerprint in addition to seed/input/state identity for deterministic claims.
evidence: FoundationDB Debugging in FDB: simulation reproducibility depends on OS/build environment
hypotheses.falsifier: Target H1 experiments demonstrate byte/semantic deterministic replay across materially different environment/toolchain fingerprints without unexplained divergence.

hypotheses.statement: A recurrence-aware effect trace can detect authority drift by enforcing capabilities_after subseteq capabilities_before unless an external authorization receipt exists.
hypotheses.falsifier: A legitimate H1 effect transition requires recurrent self-expansion of authority without any external authority event.

hypotheses.statement: A deterministic in-process replay lane should be paired with an outside-in non-deterministic full-system fault lane because each has different blind spots.
hypotheses.falsifier: On FRANK's frozen fault corpus, the outside-in lane finds no distinct failure class or coverage gain after sufficient runs while imposing material cost.

hypotheses.statement: Cross-node causal IDs should be transportable independently from canonical semantic truth, analogous to distributed tracing context.
hypotheses.falsifier: FRANK can preserve complete cross-node causal ancestry/replay without transportable trace context or the extra context creates semantic-authority confusion.

counterhypotheses.statement: One envelope becomes too large and increases state/trace amplification enough to harm the runtime.
counterhypotheses.test: Store large stage payloads content-addressed and keep only hashes/refs in the envelope; measure p50/p95/p99 latency, bytes/turn and recovery cost.

counterhypotheses.statement: Strict causal-stage validation overconstrains legitimate bypass paths.
counterhypotheses.test: Replay frozen BYPASS scenarios with explicit typed bypass receipts; validator must admit declared bypass without allowing silent stage collapse.

counterhypotheses.statement: Environment fingerprinting is too coarse or too sensitive to predict replay equivalence.
counterhypotheses.test: Factorially vary OS/runtime/dependency/build dimensions and identify the minimal fingerprint subset that predicts divergence.

counterhypotheses.statement: Semantic projection normalization can hide a meaningful implementation-specific divergence.
counterhypotheses.test: Mutation-test normalization fields and require explicit representation-normalization rules with negative fixtures before H2 PASS.

evidence_boundary: Shared project contracts plus this validator are not independent scientific replication of FRANK architecture claims.
